thread:
irinah: heads-up — I noticed a steady increase in kv resident memory for a single long-lived chat session (user session id p-7e3a) over ~3 hours. resident_bytes went from 120MB -> 1.4GB without commensurate eviction spikes.
devin: hmm that's worrying. did eviction counters move at all? which metrics did you look at?
irinah: looked at kv_resident_bytes, kv_resident_items, kv_evictions_total. evictions_total barely budged. query I ran:
```promql
sum by (model) (kv_resident_bytes{env="prod"})
/ 1024/1024
```
and per-session filter:
```promql
kv_resident_bytes{session_id="p-7e3a"}
```
samir: any chance this is fragmentation not actual growth? fragmentation can make resident_bytes high while usable items small.
irinah: checked item counts too. kv_resident_items rose proportionally. looks like more entries being retained (prefix expansion), not just fragmentation. also noticed kernel-selection change deployed last Thursday.
maggie: talk me through the timeline. kernel rollout -> batching heuristic tweak -> this session saw long contexts? could be related.
irinah: timeline lines up. session had multiple long inputs (20k tokens cumulative) and our continuous batching kept adding new KV fragments. suspect KV pages never hit eviction threshold because per-shard thresholds are coarse.
perfbot: alert created: PERF-4012 — kv-residency-growth-long-chats. linked traces: http://perf/redwood/trace/4012
devin: quick thought: we only expose kv_evictions_total as a global counter sans labels. we should add labels: model, session_id (sampled), eviction_reason. that'll let us correlate evictions to sessions.
samir: +1. also add a gauge kv_resident_bytes_by_session (sampled) and a percentile histogram of residency per-prefix-length. sampling avoids cardinality explosion.
maggie: can we get a repro locally? create a synthetic client that streams many distinct prefixes and keeps the session alive.
irinah: I already have a repro script (runs ~30m to get to 1GB). sharing gist: https://gist.company/repro-kv-drift
devin: while we instrument, can we add a short TTL on per-session KV entries (opt-in) so long tail sessions don't keep everything forever? TTL could be 2 hours for sessions created after opt-in flag.
samir: TTL helps but might affect correctness for some apps using long-term context. make it opt-in or gated by model/plan.
irinah: for observability next steps I propose:
- add labels to kv_evictions_total: model, reason, sampled_session
- add kv_resident_items_by_session (sampled) gauge
- export kv_fragmentation_ratio (gauge) per-shard
- dashboard panels: per-model resident bytes, 95th session resident bytes, evictions by reason
maggie: agreed. can you draft the PromQL and panel suggestions? I can take the PR for grafana panels.
irinah: draft PromQLs:
```promql
# total resident by model
sum by (model) (kv_resident_bytes{env="prod"})

# sampled 95th session resident (MB)
quantile_over_time(0.95, kv_resident_bytes{sampled_session="true"}[7d]) / 1024 / 1024

# evictions by reason
sum by (reason) (increase(kv_evictions_total[1h]))
```
maggie: nice. I'll add panels for session percentiles and an annotations layer for kernel rollouts.
devin: also add a small flamegraph in the repro run to rule out slow compaction path. I suspect compaction disabled after kernel change.
samir: I'll instrument eviction_reason in the C++ runtime. quick patch: attach reason labels at the site we free pages (memory_pressure|manual_compact|ttl_eviction).
irinah: thanks — I'll open an issue and attach the repro trace and heap snapshots. PERF-4012 notes updated.
maggie: timeline/owners: samir -> runtime instrumentation PR, devin -> repro + flamegraphs, me -> grafana panels, irinah -> issue + traces. target: hotfix instrumentation in next 3 days.
devin: one more note — let's also expose a counter kv_pages_reused_total to measure fragmentation reuse rate. if reuse drops while resident grows that's a smoking gun.
irinah: good call. adding it to the list.
samir: ok starting work on the C++ label change. will push a small metrics-only commit for review today. :rocket:
maggie: thanks all. keep updates in this thread and ping if you need infra for the repro env. :thumbsup:
perfbot: deploy event: metrics-agent v2.14 deployed to production (no kernel changes)
